fact: The DHIS2 for Education article states that the Ministry of Education and Training 'is in the process of modernizing its EMIS and implementing DHIS2 for Education', that the EMIS Unit holds regular webinars for system users on data entry and validation, and that the EMIS team was recently able to list the learners receiving orphan and vulnerable children bursaries for 2026 planning from learner-level records; it gives no count of schools entering data.
title: Data: The Power is in the Use
